description: Client-side script for Purchase Receipt doctype in ERPNext, handling UI interactions, button actions, and form logic.

classes.name: PurchaseReceiptController
classes.description: Controller class extending BuyingController for Purchase Receipt, managing stock ledger, buttons, and status updates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the PurchaseReceiptController, including posting date/time check.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, shows stock ledger, adds buttons based on document status.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Invoice from the Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: make_purchase_return
methods.description: Creates a Purchase Return from the Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: close_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Updates the status of the Purchase Receipt to 'Closed'.

methods.name: make_retention_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for retention purposes.
